text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh~! Is my birthday present a water gun, 
*yes*? It's so very pretty!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, and that's not all! Today's 
special! The star of the hero show is 
Taiki-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's put on that western show you love, 
Taiki-san! Our hero show troupe will give 
you our full support!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, really!? Are you sure, *yes*~!? 
There's a Western movie I absolutely love, 
*yes*!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A rancher trying to run out carrot 
farmers, and a gunslinger fighting in a 
bar! The trusty partner who comes to the 
rescue when surrounded by enemies is 
Justice Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A collab between the gunslinger and 
Justice Biko... That sounds sooo intensely 
awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Love it, love it! Then maybe I'll play the 
farmer! "Someone please protect our 
fields~!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Surrounding me to take me down? I'll 
praise you for your courage at least. 
But—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"There are two kinds of people in this 
world. Those who get shot down, and— those 
who get knocked down by fists!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Wah~! Thank you both so much~~! Now we 
can grow carrots here forever~!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"The sadness has cleared. We shall take 
our leave. Please... cherish this carrot 
patch."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“—Whoa! You look sooo cool, Gunslinger! 
Alright, let's kick off the hero show's 
special performance right now!”
